title: Violet Seed Sanctuary
description: A floating violet energy seed held between four eroded limestone sails by currents that wind around the body; references: ref_04_white_ribbed_arches and ref_07_violet_crater.

review.notes: Round 1 (new build). The concept works: 19 m, four curved limestone sails around a floating seed, currents ending in modeled stone sockets, and it reads as a rare landmark at the right scale. Defects: (1) material: the sheath uses Transmission Weight 0.72 (build.py energy_finish), and STYLE.md is explicit: 'Keine Glaskugeln, keine Transmission'. It renders as glossy translucent purple plastic or a jelly bag (closeup.jpg), which also fails 'rund/plastisch'. There is no visible bright core and no flowing filaments with narrow bright cores on a dark violet base, as in the violet_energy swatch. Use an opaque dark violet_body with emissive filament patterns and one clear bright heart that is visible through openings in the sheath. (2) form_detail: the seed is a smooth, crumpled, folded sack with no structure. Give it a readable form, for example ribbed petals or plates around a core, with sharp edges. The currents are uniform-width purple tubes with no bright core and no taper, and two of them loop and cross in front of the body (closeup.jpg, turn_020). Taper them, give them a bright inner line, and route them without crossing the seed's front. (3) style/defects: the sails are stacked blocks with uniform dark joint gaps (like a stack of tyres in turn_065/110) and grey camouflage-like mottling over the whole surface. Vary the block heights, make the joints tight with local dirt only, and keep the limestone ivory. The rear sail is tinted mauve/pink with a dark stain around its socket.
